title: Ordered derived tensor powers of the shifted finite Tate line
statement: For a scheme $T$ of universe $u$ [def-pc-scheme], a commutative ring $A$ of universe $u+1$, and $N\in\mathbb N$ with $(N:A)=0$, work in $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write $U_T=A_T[0]$ and $L_T=A_T(1)[0]$ for the concrete constant and scalar-extended positive finite Tate line of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class]. Using the existing unbounded derived tensor product [def-kun-derived-tensor], define the ordered shifted Tate powers recursively by $K_T(0)=U_T$ and $K_T(d+1)=K_T(d)\otimes_A^L L_T[2]$ for every $d\in\mathbb N$. The tensor functor has its right argument fixed to $L_T[2]$. This defines actual objects for every such $A,N,T$; it makes no assertion of local freeness or invertibility without the corresponding hypotheses.

source.place: The shifted coefficient A(d)[2d]; ordered tensor-power model used also in the projective-bundle geometric-fibre calculation.
